cover.title: 5 niche things that will make you terrifyingly good at finding where users quit

inner.title: split by device
inner.body: ga4 funnel explorations let you break a funnel down by dimensions like device category. a blended funnel can hide a step that only fails on phones.

inner.title: read the abandonments
inner.body: under a ga4 funnel, the abandonments and abandonments rate columns show where users leave between steps. most founders stare at completions, which only flatter them.

inner.title: count the rage clicks
inner.body: microsoft clarity flags a rage click when someone clicks multiple times in a clustered area in rapid succession. users show you the broken button long before they email you.

inner.title: show the total early
inner.body: baymard's research ranks extra costs as the top reason us shoppers abandon a cart, at 40%. the price you reveal last is the one they quit on.

inner.title: hunt silent errors
inner.body: 17% of us shoppers told baymard they abandoned a cart over website errors or crashes. nobody files a bug report on the way out.
